paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在相关工作中将目标论文归类为RF信号窃听方案之一，仅简要提及目标论文通过RFID捕捉扬声器振动以窃听声音，未进行具体评价或使用其方法。

evidences.evidence_quote: RF-based schemes focus on using high-frequency signals to characterize vibrations induced by the loudspeaker. These schemes mainly utilize millimeter waves [8], [9], [10], [45], [46], [47], [48], [49], RFID signals [11], [12], [13], electromagnetic signals [15], [16], [17], [18], and WiFi signals [14], among other RF signals [50].
